populate_search_engine: populate a Meilisearch search engine with embeddings from HuggingFace documentation libraries
clean_meilisearch_index: clean and optionally swap Meilisearch temp index with production index
add_gradio_documentation: add Gradio documentation embeddings to Meilisearch using HuggingFace Inference Endpoints
run_incremental_indexing: run incremental indexing to add new and changed documentation pages while deleting stale ones
skip_embedding_generation: skip embedding generation and Meilisearch upload for testing documentation processing
